title: imogene + willie x Gibson "USA" Trucker Hat

long_description.body:
A vintage-inspired trucker hat that checks all the boxes: fit, construction, quality… and, most importantly, it is made in the USA. It features an embroidered "Gibson USA" patch with a merrowed edge.





Cotton/poly twill with mesh




Snapback closure; one size fits most




Wash by hand in warm water with mild detergent
